current_contract_provenance.requirement: Report neural-only versus behavior-only and combined arms under matched access; a combined success cannot identify a neural contribution.
current_contract_provenance.history: The component branch preserves its earlier local contract bytes. Current adopted contract evidence was read at the identified commit; it is not inferred from stale local delivery prose.

presentation_policy.selector: Immutable operator choice; no participant modality-switch action.
presentation_policy.omitted_panels: Blank and explicitly unavailable, not synthetic measured zeros.
presentation_policy.combined_pixel_identity: Delegate to the unchanged original combined renderer.
presentation_policy.matched_access: Same training labels, query order, time support, included-lane geometry, canvas, gain range and typed actions. Freeze one shared action/image/byte/wall budget before all three conditions.
presentation_policy.labels: Training context labels permitted; query labels and other-fold identities refused.
presentation_policy.context_boundary: Fresh participant process, writable state and model context for every condition and held-mouse fold; no cross-condition sharing of prior images/answers. Operator state/episode IDs do not attest this external boundary.
presentation_policy.collection: All seven condition-bound histories required; mixed condition, budget, source or input identities fail. Old combined history formats are not relabelable.

six_reference_streams.provenance: Previously frozen benchmark-authored programme comparators, not the original paper's classifiers. No reference output is recomputed or replaced.
six_reference_streams.glial: Eighteen calcium distribution, temporal and coactivity summaries.
six_reference_streams.behavior: Two binary-state summaries: occupancy and adjacent transition fraction.
six_reference_streams.combined: Twenty features: eighteen glial plus two behavior.
six_reference_streams.time_scrambled: The fitted glial model on query-only independent per-cell temporal permutations, PCG64 seed34034. Training remains unscrambled; this is not a sixth fitted classifier or permutation significance test.
six_reference_streams.fit: Four active-training-only StandardScaler plus L2 LogisticRegression pipelines, C1/lbfgs/max_iter1000/tol1e-8; no query-label tuning.
six_reference_streams.access_caveat: Legacy prediction code loads and computes both modalities before selecting classifier features. Its restricted-feature names do not attest restricted participant access.

interpretation_limits: Use the same frozen candidate/model family and inference policy across viewer conditions. Programme-reference versus viewer differences also change algorithm, representation and execution profile.
A matched viewer contrast is descriptive on this selected historically exposed seven-mouse panel, not a causal effect of calcium in the animal.
ROI selection, whole-session processing, context/day order and behavior polarity remain unresolved source limitations.
No eleven-mouse/raw-microscopy coverage, no-tools native understanding, external image consumption, model context reset or whole-task readiness is established.
